104: ## PR1.10 — PARTIAL-IMPORT WRAPPER BLOCKER FIX (fresh resilience review)
105: 
106: A fresh resilience review of the PR1 baseline found that the
107: `local-fallback` post-auth-sync status alone was not enough to keep
108: local diagnostic and study-plan data visible: even when status was
109: `local-fallback`, the persistence adapter selector could still go
110: remote (because `hasRemoteSession` is set independently by the UI),
111: and the wrapper for `loadDiagnosticResult`/`loadStudyPlan` used the
112: plain `attempt()` helper, which treats a successful remote `null`
113: read as authoritative. That hid any local diagnostic or study plan
114: the student had completed.
115: 
116: The `loadProgress` branch already had the right structure (specialized
117: two-stage recovery that recovers local on remote-empty). This task
118: applies the same invariant to the nullable READ methods.
119: 
120: - [x] E1 RED `src/lib/persistence/__tests__/selector.test.ts`: 10 new tests across two new describe blocks — `loadDiagnosticResult remote-null + local-has branch` and `loadStudyPlan remote-null + local-has branch`. Each block covers: (1) BLOCKER FIX remote null + local has → local + fallback event; (2) sanity remote null + local null → null (no event); (3) sanity remote real + local null → remote (no event); (4) regression remote throws → local + fallback event; (5) regression remote `__remoteUnavailable` + local has → local + fallback event.
121: - [x] E1 GREEN `src/lib/persistence/selector.ts`: extended `withLocalFallback.loadDiagnosticResult` and `withLocalFallback.loadStudyPlan` with the same two-stage structure as `loadProgress` — Stage 1 (sentinel + throws → local + fallback event, sentinel never leaks) then Stage 2 (remote `null` + local has data → local + fallback event; remote has data → remote wins; both `null` → local `null`).
122: - [x] E1 hygiene: extended `makeRemoteAdapter` / `makeLocalAdapter` test helpers to accept optional `loadDiagnosticResult` / `loadStudyPlan` overrides with `null`-default (backward-compatible with existing 8 `loadProgress` tests).
